preToolUse.bash:
input="$(cat)"
if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eiq '(sudo[[:space:]]+)?\brm\b[[:space:]]+(-[^[:space:]]*r[^[:space:]]*f[^[:space:]]*|-[^[:space:]]*f[^[:space:]]*r[^[:space:]]*|--recursive[[:space:]]+.*--force|--force[[:space:]]+.*--recursive)[[:space:]]+/+\*?[[:space:]]*($|[;&|])'; then
  printf '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: recursive force-delete targeting root (/) is destructive and irreversible."}'
  exit 0
fi
if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eiq '\b(curl|wget)\b[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(sh|bash|zsh)\b'; then
  printf '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: piping a remote script directly into a shell interpreter bypasses review."}'
  exit 0
fi
if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eiq '\bgit[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+(--force(-with-lease)?|-f)\b.*\b(origin[[:space:]]+)?(main|master)\b'; then
  printf '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: force-pushing to a protected branch (main/master) can overwrite team history."}'
  exit 0
fi
if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eiq '\bchmod[[:space:]]+(-R[[:space:]]+)?0?777\b'; then
  printf '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: chmod 777 grants world-writable permissions, a common security misconfiguration."}'
  exit 0
fi
exit 0
